usages.source_text_exact: Conduct an initial pressure test before renovation to verify the air barrier meets current leakage rate per the requirements of the International Green Construction Code (IgCC).

usages.source_heading: CHAPTER 3 DESIGN > 3-7 AIR BARRIER DESIGN AND TESTING. > 3-7.2 Modifications. > 3-7.2.3 Major envelope modifications without existing air barrier.

usages.source_text_exact: Continuous air barrier inspection and testing must be in accordance with the requirements of IgCC with building air leakage rate not exceeding 0.25 cfm/ft2 (1.25 L/m2) under a pressure differential of 0.3 inches of water (75 Pa) when tested.
